name: RCO-A2A
description: RCO-A2A serves Regulatory Compliance Objects: signed, deterministic, machine-verifiable compliance state per GTIN per jurisdiction, resolved upstream — agents consume the result of the rules, not the rules. Four read tools (resolve_compliance, get_record, list_rule_sets, list_issuers) are session-free, require no account, and return typed responses; one write tool (publish_record) is the controlled issuer path on the partner rail and requires an issuer subscription key. Every record carries its issuer, key id and verification URL; records verify from the public keyring at dpuone.ai and are receipted on Azure Confidential Ledger. Rule sets are versioned and hashed per jurisdiction (49 members + apex under SM-ECO-10060). The protocol layer — record schema, tool contract, signal vocabulary — is MIT at github.com/greencore-solutions/rco-a2a. Operated by GreenCore Solutions Corp., Microsoft AI Cloud Partner, D-U-N-S 24-336-6774, GS1 Canada licensee.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RCO-A2A to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RCO-A2A to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rco-a2a.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is RCO-A2A MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, RCO-A2A scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RCO-A2A MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RCO-A2A provides these MCP tools: get_record, list_issuers, list_rule_sets, publish_record, and resolve_compliance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RCO-A2A?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to RCO-A2A in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and Square Yards.
RCO-A2A does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
RCO-A2A is developed by GreenCore Solutions Corp.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
